title: Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Slovakian-inspired pork stew made with tender pork and root vegetables.

ingredients.name: slovakian stew
ingredients.notes: available at most European grocery stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the pork cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onion, carrot, and celery until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Slovakian stew and beef broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the pork to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the pork is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with a dollop of sour cream if desired.
